title: Creamy Pesto Dressing
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh/Dinnerly sachet. No published ingredient list could be found, so this is a sensible copycat. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Whisk the pesto, mayonnaise, lemon juice and water until creamy. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
